atoms.b: To convert a fraction with a denominator that is not 10, 100 or 1,000 to a decimal number, first find ((++an_equivalent a_larger)) fraction that does have denominator 10, 100 or 1,000.

To find an equivalent decimal to 1/2, first find an equivalent fraction with denominator 10, 100 or 1,000.

1/2=++5/10 5/100 2/10
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to <mat>1/2</mat>, first find an equivalent fraction with denominator 10, 100 or 1,000. 1 half is equal to 5 tenths.

atoms.b:
To find an equivalent decimal to 5/10, write 5 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it.

5/10=++0.5 50 0.05
1/2=++0.5 50 0.05
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to <mat>5/10</mat>, write 5 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it. 5 tenths is equal to 0.5, so 1 half is also equal to 0.5.
